text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's finally done it! She's
taken the
title of Triple Crown
champion!
Wooooo!

Mihono Bourbon stands motionless as
the zealous
cheers of the crowd envelop
her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Last year I cried in disappointment, but
now I'm
about to cry tears of joy!

text_block_list.name: Short-haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: Bourbon! You're truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm... a Triple Crown champion!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Father... Trainer... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Bour-bon! Bour-bon! Bour-bon!
Bour-bon!

Suddenly, the audience breaks into a
chant that
doesn't die down for quite
some time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Your orders have been successfully
executed,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's all because of your precise
guidance... and
your faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I can finally report to my father that I
have achieved my dream. I'm
experiencing high levels
of joy right
now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Well, we have achieved this goal, but
my other
objective still remains.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I still have to "inspire" others and show
everyone
the value of hard work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood!
choice_data_list: Let's make that dream come true to...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I would like to request
detailed
instructions.

We need a platform upon which Mihono
Bourbon
can demonstrate her abilities to
the fullest extent.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho... a 3,200-meter

long-distance G1 race.

I tell her she will inspire courage in
people by
running there, to which she
responds with a nod.
choice_data_list: I know you can run all the way thr...
I know you can run all the way thr...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Although I don't understand the
relationship between racing and
inspiring others, I will carry
out your
orders to the best of my ability.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now making careful adjustments for the
spring
Tenno Sho.

Just as we arrive at the academy,
Mihono
Bourbon comes to a sudden
standstill.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: An unknown error has occurred...

Looking confused, she holds a hand to
her chest
and closes her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're coming up on the fourth corner of
the
Kikuka Sho, and Rice Shower is
pulling toward the
front!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Her speed, her intensity, her gaze, her

breathing—is this Rice's "spirit"?)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...Why am I so interested in Rice in the
middle of
a race?)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Footage from the Kikuka Sho is
automatically
replaying in my mind. I can
vividly see Rice
running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying this imagery, I detect an

"unsettled" feeling deep in my chest.
What is it?

I'm relieved that she's not in some kind
of
physical pain. Still, I'm not sure what
is causing
her discomfort.

It's possible that thinking of Rice Shower
is
causing her some anxiety...

Suddenly, a group of shrill-voiced high
school
girls walk by.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Like, did you see it?! Mihono Bourbon
won the
Kikuka Sho and became a Triple
Crowner!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I saw! That was sooo awesome!
Can't
believe she won it all!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Too bad Teio got hurt last year. Who do
you
think would win if they went
head-to-head?

Mihono Bourbon is happily browsing the
news on
her phone, seemingly oblivious
to them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Tokai... Teio...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recurrence of "unsettled" feeling
confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I don't know...
choice_data_list: Could it be... you're worried abou...

text_block_list.text:
She holds her chest with a perplexed
expression.

The two of them have been compared
time and
time again, but she's never
once paid any mind to
Tokai Teio.

And it's not just Tokai Teio—she has the
same
sensation in her chest when she
thinks about Rice
Shower.

Perhaps this is the true nature of the
"unsettled" feeling she's been having
since the Kikuka Sho.
Maybe she's
changing more than I realized.

I just hope it doesn't negatively impact
her
performance in the spring Tenno
Sho...
